title: Fyre Festival: $1.46 Million Real, $34.79 Million on Paper — The Billy McFarland Verdict
summary: Between May 2016 and April 2017, Fyre Media's booking app confirmed 60 paid bookings worth $57,443 in fees. Investors were shown tens of millions. Built from the FBI's criminal complaint, the charging papers, the government's sentencing memorandum, the judgment and the court record, this is how Billy McFarland built the numbers behind Fyre Media and Fyre Festival, what investors were promised about the island, the ticket scam he ran while out on bail, why Judge Naomi Reice Buchwald called him a "serial fraudster" and sentenced him to six years — and what happened after.
